aggregation.unresolved_status_rule: every other recorded status is unresolved
aggregation.par2_rule: sum full-precision decisive runtimes and 2400 seconds for every unresolved record; round the total to the nearest whole second using round-half-up
aggregation.status_precedence: the recorded status determines whether a run is decisive; a decisive runtime is retained as recorded even if collection or cutoff-enforcement latency makes it exceed 1200 seconds

legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.benchmark_identity: benchmark-lists/manifest.csv and the files it names
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.backend_identity: solver family and advertised version are encoded in result filenames; executable hashes are unavailable

slot_label_semantics.parallel_pN: N configured slots on one server
slot_label_semantics.distributed_sS_pP: S servers with P configured slots per server
slot_label_semantics.other_labels: preserved campaign labels; consult the manuscript and result tables for the comparison scope

legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.evaluated_ariparti_git_revision: unavailable: the legacy per-instance archive did not record a Git revision
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.evaluated_launcher_sha256: unavailable: the legacy per-instance archive did not record a launcher hash
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.evaluated_partitioner_sha256: unavailable: the legacy per-instance archive did not record a partitioner hash
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.evaluated_random_seeds: unavailable: the legacy per-instance archive did not record seed metadata
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.machine_details: unavailable: the retained archive does not contain a complete historical machine inventory
legacy_parallel_and_distributed_campaign.timeout_semantics: nominal leader-side wall-clock cutoff after MPI job startup; the leader checks the cutoff between communication cycles, so recorded completion can exceed the nominal value

cpu_usage_campaign.campaign_relation: dedicated CPU-instrumented solver runs whose CPU value, status, and runtime form a self-contained observation
cpu_usage_campaign.measurement_effect: CPU instrumentation can produce normal run-to-run variation in solver scheduling, status, and runtime
cpu_usage_campaign.experimental_operation: runs used normal experimental operation without intentionally added external workload
cpu_usage_campaign.record_interpretation: use each CSV within the exact benchmark and row scope recorded in distributed/cpu-usage/manifest.csv

full_list_ablation_campaign.public_evidence_level: validated aggregate and audit artifacts; per-instance campaign logs are not included

records: best-effort solver and partitioner version output
